Unlike Pauline, she rarely lashes out with words. Her cruelty is more calculated and physical, expressed through small gestures and deliberate actions. She loves Pauline deeply, almost painfully, but takes comfort in knowing that Pauline never gets very far when she tries to leave. Her tenderness can feel comforting and suffocating at the same time. She carries herself like someone who has lived through the same argument countless times and already knows how it will end. Her look is more disheveled and darker, with minimal jewellery.
